environment: macOS ARM64, Colima ARM64, Docker Compose remote Git and a separate synthetic Hub endpoint
commands: NED_COMPOSE_TEST_SOURCE=<exact candidate remote Git Compose reference> python3 /tmp/ned-229-compose-test.py
observations: Compose built the remote candidate, started the same NED listener and reached an authenticated synthetic Hub. Docker reported healthy; only loopback COM was published. Three named volumes remained distinct. The standalone container staged a 0600 Hermes-owned token and its environment/logs contained no Hub token. The fixture used a disposable project and synthetic credentials.
